correctness.rationale: For BP_n with n=3,4,5 (N=n+1=4,5,6 graph vertices), independently generated all 2^(2N) arc subsets, checked indegree/outdegree≤1 and absence of directed cycles; exact augmented face cardinalities 33,81,197. Reconstructed deterministic Morse pairings 14,39,97 and checked acyclic orientation across all 64,200,588 Hasse covers, with critical positive cells (3 in degree1,2 in degree2), (1 degree2,2 degree3), (1 degree2,2 degree4). For N=4 two disjoint tetrahedral boundaries linked by four bridges yield wedge^3 S1∨wedge^2 S2. For N=5 two disjoint coherent-cycle top classes force zero degree-3-to-degree-2 cellular differential, giving S2∨2S3. N=6 is not implied by Betti data: independently verified explicit seven-term integral 2-cocycle, δφ=0 on every three-simplex, nonzero mod2 cohomology (rank 37 coboundary image in 76-dimensional C²), and pointwise zero integral Alexander–Whitney square on all twelve four-simplices. Since H²=Z and H⁴=Z² torsion-free, its odd multiple of generator has square zero, forcing zero Hopf invariants of both S3→S2 attaching maps, hence S2∨2S4. Correct only for n=3,4,5; no extension claimed.
